narrative.overview:
A well-kept revision notebook: warm paper, dark brown ink, and a single red-orange pen used to mark what matters. The page is built to be read for a long time, usually by a student the night before an exam, so legibility comes before every other decision. Type is large, line height is generous (1.8 for body text), and contrast is high.

The system is calm and sure of itself. Surfaces are flat paper, separated by thin rules rather than shadows. Controls respond clearly but never play. There is no glow, no gradient decoration, no emoji, no bento grid, and no purple or blue anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals tinted toward brown, never cool grey.
One accent (the red-orange pen) carries all emphasis; green and red appear only as answer feedback.
Thai-first typography with a monospace voice for code, numbers, and labels.
Thin rules and tonal steps for structure; shadow is rare.
Readable on a phone at arm's length, offline, from a single file.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: The red-orange accent is the only decorative colour. Green, red, and amber exist to report answer state and warnings, never to decorate.

rules.name: The No Cool Colour Rule
rules.body: No blue, purple, or cool grey in the palette or in syntax colours.

rules.name: The Reading First Rule
rules.body: Body text is never smaller than 1rem and never tighter than 1.7 line height; small sizes are for metadata only.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks code, numbers, and system labels; prose is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Flat Until Touched Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift and shadow are a response to pointer hover only.

dos: Do keep text at 1rem or larger with a 1.7 to 1.8 line height for anything the student must read.
Do use Pen Red for the single most important thing on a screen and let paper and ink carry the rest.
Do pair every correct/wrong colour with an icon or text.
Do keep the manual light/dark toggle and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Do mark author-added content with a "หมายเหตุ" note callout.
donts: Don't use purple or blue, or cool greys.
Don't use emoji, glow effects, heavy gradients, bento grids, or decorative fake code imagery.
Don't use shadows at rest; lift only on hover.
Don't add a second accent colour for decoration.
Don't shrink body copy to fit more on screen; scroll instead.
